cluster_name.description: Optional name for the cluster. Useful in multi-cluster deployments for identification.

server_id.description: Unique ID for this server instance. Auto-generated if not set.

host.description: IP address or hostname the NATS server will bind to for client connections.

monitoring.description: Port for HTTP monitoring and dashboard (set to 0 or omit to disable).

cluster.description: Port used for server-to-server cluster communication.

cluster_host.description: IP address to bind the cluster listen socket to.

password.description: Password for intra-cluster authentication (recommended to use JWT or TLS auth instead in production).

cluster_auth.description: Cluster authorization credentials (optional). Prefer JWT/TLS auth in production.

cluster_routes.description: List of other NATS servers to connect to for cluster formation (format: nats://host:port).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the route peer.

jetstream_enabled.description: Enable JetStream persistent streaming and queueing subsystem.

jetstream_store_dir.description: Directory for JetStream data storage (required if JetStream is enabled).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_pending_bytes.description: Maximum bytes a client can have pending (unprocessed messages) — 0 = unlimited.

write_deadline.description: Write timeout (seconds) for client connections before disconnect.

system_account.description: System account ID (JWT or nkey) used for internal server operations.

no_log.description: Disable logging output entirely (not recommended for production).

log_file.description: Path to log file (if omitted, logs go to stdout/stderr).

trace.description: Enable verbose protocol trace logging (use only for debugging).

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file.

ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for client verification (optional).

verify.description: Require client certificate verification (set to true when using client certs).

tls.description: TLS configuration for secure client connections (recommended in production).

accounts.description: Static account definitions (use JWT for dynamic/multi-tenancy deployments).

users.description: List of users for this account.

password.description: Password (prefer nkeys or JWT in production).
